sents.t: My phone bill was getting more expensive every month.
So on Saturday, I went to the phone store on Main Street to compare plans.

“The Basic plan is the cheapest. It’s thirty-five dollars a month, but it has the least data. The Plus plan costs fifty dollars and has more data. The Unlimited plan is the most expensive, seventy dollars, but it’s the best for people who watch a lot of videos.”
“Which plan is the most popular?” I asked.
“Plus. It’s cheaper than Unlimited, and it’s better than Basic for most people.”
I use about ten gigabytes a month.
Plus has fifteen gigabytes, and it includes free calls to my country.
That’s the most important thing for me.
“If you sign a two-year contract, you get a discount,” Jen said.
I didn’t want a contract, so I chose month to month.
Now I pay ten dollars less every month, and I can talk to my mom for longer!
